images.title: Pair each 2 with a 3
images.purpose: Shows 2⁴ × 3⁴ as four pairs of a 2 and a 3, each pair making 6, so 2⁴ × 3⁴ = 6⁴ = 1296.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One row of four rounded pair boxes, each holding one teal and one amber circle.
images.exact_structure: One row of four equal rounded boxes with reddish purple (#CC79A7) outlines, evenly spaced. Each box holds one teal (#0072B2) circle and one amber (#E69F00) circle side by side; only in the first box do the circles carry the digits 2 and 3, the other six circles are plain. Above the row the label 2⁴ × 3⁴. Below the row the label (2 × 3)⁴ = 6⁴ = 1296. To the right of the row, a small key reads each pair = 6. Exactly 4 boxes and 8 circles. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: When the exponents are equal, multiply the bases: 2⁴ × 3⁴ = 6⁴.

image_decisions.why: Regrouping factors into pairs is the reason the same exponent rule works.
